## Setup

### Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(bayesplot)
library(knitr)
library(here)
```

### Import imputed df

```{r import-data}
analytic_dfs <- readRDS(here("Imputed Data", "analytic_dfs.rds"))
```

### Initial checks

```{r imp-dfs-list}
head(analytic_dfs[[1]])
length(unique(analytic_dfs[[1]]$LinkCode))
```

## 1. Preparation

### 1.1 Set up formulas and helper function

```{r hypothesis-formulas}
formula_h1 <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pds_total_s * adhd_status 
                 + age_cont_s + sed_percentile_s)

formula_h2 <- bf(ers_total_s ~ pubertal_timing_s * adhd_status 
                 + sed_percentile_s)

yrep_summary_tbl <- tibble()

fmt_prior <- function(ps, cls) {
  ps <- as.data.frame(ps)
  r <- ps[ps$class == cls & ps$coef == "" & ps$group == "", ][1, ]
  out <- gsub(" ", "", r$prior)
  out <- sub("^normal", "N", out)
  out <- sub("^student_t", "t", out)
  out <- sub("^exponential", "Exponential", out)
  if (r$source == "default") paste0(out, "*") else out
}

# Helper function
run_prior_pred_check <- function(formula, data, prior, label,
                                  model_label, prior_set_label,
                                  chains = 4, iter = 2000, seed = 1234) {

  model <- brm(
    formula = formula,
    data = data,
    family = gaussian(),
    prior = prior,
    chains = chains,
    iter = iter,
    sample_prior = "only",
    seed = seed
  )

  set.seed(seed)
  yrep     <- posterior_predict(model)
  yrep_vec <- as.vector(yrep)
  qs       <- quantile(yrep_vec, c(.01, .05, .5, .95, .99))

  cat("\n===", label, "===\n")

  cat("\n-- yrep summary --\n")
  print(range(yrep_vec))
  cat("mean:  ", mean(yrep_vec), "\n")
  cat("median:", median(yrep_vec), "\n")
  cat("sd:    ", sd(yrep_vec), "\n")

  cat("\n-- yrep quantiles --\n")
  print(qs)

  cat("\n-- ppd_stat distributions --\n")
  print(ppd_stat(yrep, stat = "mean"))
  print(ppd_stat(yrep, stat = "median"))
  print(ppd_stat(yrep, stat = "sd"))

  cat("\n-- prior summary --\n")
  print(prior_summary(model))

  cat("\n-- model summary --\n")
  print(summary(model))

  ps <- prior_summary(model)

  row <- tibble(
    Model             = model_label,
    `Prior Set`       = prior_set_label,
    `b Prior`         = fmt_prior(ps, "b"),
    `Intercept Prior` = fmt_prior(ps, "Intercept"),
    `Sigma Prior`     = fmt_prior(ps, "sigma"),
    `yrep M`          = mean(yrep_vec),
    `yrep Mdn`        = median(yrep_vec),
    `yrep SD`         = sd(yrep_vec),
    q01               = qs[["1%"]],
    q05               = qs[["5%"]],
    q95               = qs[["95%"]],
    q99               = qs[["99%"]]
  )
  yrep_summary_tbl <<- bind_rows(yrep_summary_tbl, row)

  invisible(model)
}
```

### 1.2 Set up priors

```{r priors}
prior_prereg <- prior(normal(0, 1), class = b)

prior_set_1 <- prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b)

prior_set_2 <- c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                 prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))

prior_set_3 <- c(prior(normal(0, 0.5), class = b),
                 prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))

prior_set_4 <- c(prior(normal(0, 1), class = b),
                 prior(normal(0, 1), class = Intercept),
                 prior(exponential(1), class = sigma))
```

## 2. Prior predictive checks

### 2.1 Preregistered prior predictive checks

```{r prereg-prior-pred-check}
prior_prereg_model_h1 <- run_prior_pred_check(
  formula = formula_h1, data = analytic_dfs[[1]], prior = prior_prereg,
  label = "yrep model 1 (preregistered prior)", seed = 1234,
  model_label = "H1", prior_set_label = "Preregistered"
)

prior_prereg_model_h2 <- run_prior_pred_check(
  formula = formula_h2, data = analytic_dfs[[1]], prior = prior_prereg,
  label = "yrep model 2 (preregistered prior)", seed = 1234,
  model_label = "H2", prior_set_label = "Preregistered"
)

prior_summary(prior_prereg_model_h1)
prior_summary(prior_prereg_model_h2)
```

### 2.2 Prior set 1 prior predictive checks

```{r prior1-pred-check}
prior_set_1_model_h1 <- run_prior_pred_check(
  formula = formula_h1, data = analytic_dfs[[1]], prior = prior_set_1,
  label = "yrep model 1 (prior set 1)", seed = 1234,
  model_label = "H1", prior_set_label = "Set 1"
)

prior_set_1_model_h2 <- run_prior_pred_check(
  formula = formula_h2, data = analytic_dfs[[1]], prior = prior_set_1,
  label = "yrep model 2 (prior set 1)", seed = 1234,
  model_label = "H2", prior_set_label = "Set 1"
)

prior_summary(prior_set_1_model_h1)
prior_summary(prior_set_1_model_h2)
```

### 2.6 Summary table

```{r prior-pred-summary-table}
yrep_summary_display <- yrep_summary_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    `yrep 5th–95th percentile` = sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", q05, q95),
    `yrep 1st–99th percentile` = sprintf("%.2f to %.2f", q01, q99),
    across(c(`yrep M`, `yrep Mdn`, `yrep SD`), ~ round(.x, 2))
  ) %>%
  select(Model, `Prior Set`, `b Prior`, `Intercept Prior`, `Sigma Prior`,
         `yrep M`, `yrep Mdn`, `yrep SD`,
         `yrep 5th–95th percentile`, `yrep 1st–99th percentile`)

kable(yrep_summary_display, digits = 2, align = "c")
```
